driver_archetypes.rationale: Standard car behavior targeting M1/car discharge headway (observed 0.3467s) and low early-start share (M2/early/car ~0.011). Increased from 0.75 to 0.85 share to reduce the high queue length (M5) seen in previous iterations, while keeping impatience moderate.

Highly impatient car archetype to match M2/early/car observed share (~0.011). Increased lcImpatience and lcAssertive to drive early creep more aggressively, compensating for the lower base probability in the rule.

Standard compliant motorcycle behavior targeting M1/moto discharge headway (observed 0.2957s) and reducing overshoot depth by aligning to the right side of the lane (M4/overshoot_share). Reduced share from 0.4 to 0.35 to balance with slow riders.

Slow motorcycle archetype to replicate M4/lat_moto (lateral position ~7m from origin) and M4/overshoot_share metrics by riding in lane center with slower acceleration. Increased share from 0.6 to 0.65 to balance the total 'moto' distribution sum to exactly 1.

Violating motorcycle archetype (custom1) that joins the 'moto_violator' distribution to model illegal left turns from HDT_N/S and queue seeking behaviors (M8/moto wrong-lane share). High lcSublane pushes vehicle into adjacent lanes (wrong lane) to mimic illegal left-turn behavior from HDT_N/S.

traci_rules.rationale: Moderate early start creep window and probability for cars to match M2/early/car share (target ~0.011). Reduced p from previous iterations to avoid overshooting the low observed mean while keeping t_before_green high enough to capture natural variance.

Enables red-light running for standard motorcycles to match M3/share/moto (target ~0.098) and M3/per_cycle (target ~3.913). Adjusted p0 to balance between the observed high share and the need to avoid excessive collisions, using swarm effect k.

Adds extra hold time for illegal left-turning motorcycles to match M6/approach/l/moto entry timing (target ~53.58s) and reduce excessive holding times seen in previous iterations. Keeping at 2.5s ensures they don't clear the box too early relative to the opposing stream.

description: Adjusted archetype shares, lateral parameters, and rule probabilities to reduce red-light running rates, correct early-start share for cars, and enable lane encroachment for violating motorcycles while maintaining realistic discharge headways and mitigating excessive queue lengths and collisions. Fixed 'moto' distribution sum to exactly 1.
